en: \[Claude Tag] Added a private Allow once / Deny card in Slack threads for connector actions that need your approval, so Claude asks instead of refusing; others only see that it's waiting on you
zh: \[Claude Tag] 在 Slack 线程中为需要你批准的 connector 操作新增私密的“允许一次 / 拒绝”卡片，让 Claude 主动询问而非直接拒绝；其他人只能看到它正在等待你处理
